name: Low-Profile 75-Percent Mechanical Keyboard
description: A low-profile 75-percent mechanical keyboard with a slim anodised slate-grey aluminium case, blank PBT keycaps in a two-tone scheme of off-white alphas and slate-grey modifiers, a knurled slate aluminium rotary knob at the top-right corner, and white backlighting edge-lit beneath the caps.
materials: anodised slate-grey aluminium case, blank PBT keycaps in off-white and slate grey, low-profile mechanical switches, knurled slate aluminium rotary knob
primaryColors: slate grey anodised aluminium, off-white PBT keycaps, slate-grey PBT modifiers
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the aluminium case, the rotary knob, or the underside, and never render legends, letters, numerals, icons, or symbols on any keycap, every cap staying completely blank; never render a numeric keypad, a second rotary knob, a full-size layout, an RGB rainbow spill, tall sculpted high-profile keycaps, or a visible seam splitting the case; never swap the anodised slate aluminium for plastic or the PBT caps for glossy translucent ones, and never lose the two-tone off-white and slate scheme Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the slim anodised slate-grey aluminium case with its low front lip, the 75-percent layout with one row of function keys, a dedicated arrow cluster at the lower right and a single column of four navigation keys along the right edge and no numeric pad, the two-tone scheme of blank off-white alphas against blank slate-grey modifiers, the one knurled slate aluminium rotary knob at the top-right corner, the single USB-C port centred on the rear edge, and the neutral white backlighting must read identically in every angle, same case height, key spacing and knob position throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
